limits: No DOCX/PDF rendering performed by this agent; parent will rebuild and inspect changed Table 2 layout.
Per-destination replacement only; whole-project transactions and crash/power-loss durability are not certified.

OPC validation is retained; full OOXML schema and image decoding remain outside scope.
